description: This Java source file defines the AlertValidator class, which implements the Spring Validator interface to validate Alert objects within the OpenMRS medical record system. It checks for non-null, non-empty, and properly length fields in Alert instances.

classes.name: AlertValidator
classes.description: A class that validates Alert objects to ensure required fields are present and conform to length constraints, used within the OpenMRS framework.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if the class type is compatible with Alert for validation.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on an Alert object, ensuring 'text' is non-empty and within length constraints, throwing an exception if the object is not an Alert.
